text.en: Pet owners praise Lauren for her kind, approachable, and non-judgmental guidance during private training sessions. Clients appreciate that she breaks concepts into realistic steps and remains readily accessible for ongoing questions. Handlers credit her with easing owner anxiety during challenging stages.

Clients describe major improvements in managing leash reactivity, emotional regulation, and puppy manners after working with Lauren. Several reviewers note that previously stressful neighbourhood walks became enjoyable and calm outings. Families also report successful separation anxiety management.

Reviewers emphasize Lauren's focus on animal welfare, highlighting that she checks for underlying physical discomfort or pain before addressing behavioral issues. Handlers note that dogs build confidence and learn to work through difficult emotions in a safe and supportive manner.

q.en: Does Focus Dog Training support dogs with reactivity?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently seek help for leash reactivity, and Lauren provides personalized strategies to identify triggers and regulate arousal.
Yes, reviewers mention booking pre-puppy preparation sessions to discuss house routines, puppy management, and alone time.

q.en: Does the trainer evaluate physical health alongside behaviour?

a.en: Yes, clients report that Lauren recommends physiotherapy assessments when suspected discomfort could be influencing behavior.

q.en: How are private training sessions structured?

a.en: Training involves one-to-one sessions tailored to individual dogs, accompanied by practical homework broken into manageable steps.
